EVENT NAME: JETBLUE FLIGHT 543 EMERGENCY LANDING AND AIRPORT OPERATIONS PAUSE
NEWSLETTER DESCRIPTION: FLIGHTS PAUSED AT NEWARK AIRPORT AFTER EMERGENCY LANDING FORCES OPERATIONS HALT!
DESCRIPTION: FLIGHTS INTO NEWARK LIBERTY INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT WERE PAUSED WEDNESDAY EVENING AFTER A JETBLUE FLIGHT MADE AN EMERGENCY LANDING DUE TO REPORTED ENGINE FAILURE. JETBLUE FLIGHT 543, AN AIRBUS A320 HEADED TO PALM BEACH, RETURNED TO NEWARK SHORTLY AFTER TAKEOFF WHEN THE CREW REPORTED AN ENGINE ISSUE. AFTER LANDING AND EXITING THE RUNWAY, SMOKE WAS REPORTED IN THE COCKPIT AND PASSENGERS WERE EVACUATED USING EMERGENCY SLIDES. AIRPORT OFFICIALS TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED OPERATIONS WHILE THE AIRCRAFT WAS REMOVED FROM THE TAXIWAY. THE DISABLED AIRCRAFT HAS SINCE BEEN CLEARED AND THE AFFECTED RUNWAY HAS REOPENED, BUT DELAYS MAY CONTINUE ACROSS AIRLINES AS AIR TRAFFIC WORKS TO FULLY RECOVER. THERE ARE NO REPORTED INJURIES AT THIS TIME, AND THE FAA IS INVESTIGATING.
